text:
sam_design: pushed two mocks for the starter rail: 1) compact collapsible rail (chevron open inline) 2) inline mini-tour cards that expand below the header. both live in figma link. thoughts?

rui_research: saw the prototype. users liked the compact rail on mobile tests — less intrusive. desktop heatmaps show clicks concentrated on the first card, so ordering matters.

tanya_prod: ordering should surface 'Create API key' and 'Try a sample' first. metrics: click-to-first-api, conversions from sample -> deploy. can we do a quick taxonomy for sample types?

sam_design: yep — grouping idea: Foundations (hello-world, echo), Data (embed, search), Apps (chat, rerank). each card will have a microcopy line and duration estimate like '5–10 min'.

kevin_engineering: technical constraints: the collapsible rail only renders sample thumbnails when expanded to avoid loading dozens of images. also we need to ensure layout doesn't shift on expand — use fixed height + internal scroll.

aria_access: a11y notes: 1) collapsible control needs `aria-expanded` and clear label, 2) keyboard: pressing Enter/Space on chevron should open and focus first interactive in panel, 3) when panel opens, trap focus if it's modal-ish or else use `aria-hidden` on background. recommend non-modal with focus management that returns focus to trigger on close.

sam_design: good call. my plan: non-modal panel for accessibility. when expanded, focus -> first sample card link; close returns to chevron. also will add `sr-only` descriptions on thumbnails.

rui_research: quick note from user tests: people expected 'Try sample' to create a workspace. change copy to 'Open sample' to reduce friction?

tanya_prod: prefer 'Open sample' — less commitment. use 'Open sample' on CTA and 'Preview' for the quick peek.

kevin_engineering: implementing keyboard handler now. snippet: `document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeRail(); });` also will set `railTrigger.focus()` after close.

aria_access: also ensure focus-visible CSS is preserved; don't remove outline. contrast: the light blue badge on cards is failing AA for small text (3.2:1). please swap to `#0b66ff` or use bold text.

sam_design: updated token to `brand-blue-700` to hit 4.6:1. left the focus ring at 3px.

kevin_engineering: backend note: samples endpoint will accept `?variant=compactRail` to filter curated set. we'll gate on `user.flags.onboard_rail_v2`.

tanya_prod: great. AB plan: 50/50 compact rail vs inline cards for 10k new users. primary metric: sample-open rate; secondary: time-to-first-api-key.

rui_research: quick prototype feedback: add a lightweight tooltip on hover that reads sample time estimate; users liked seeing duration.

sam_design: added tooltip and updated microcopy for durations. also trimmed hero heading to 'Welcome to Redwood Inference' per docs consistency.

aria_access: I'll raise ENG-ONBOARD-210 with checklist: keyboard flow, screenreader labels (NVDA/VoiceOver), contrast checks. will include keystroke scenarios.

onboard-bot: reminder  link figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/starter-rail; attach ENG-ONBOARD-210 to the PR.

kevin_engineering: timeline: will ship front-end PR Wed, backend flag + endpoint Thu. need design token PR before EOD tomorrow.

tanya_prod: if any dev blockers surface, call them out here. otherwise we'll start AB specs in analytics tool tomorrow. :rocket:
